chunks: And in the narration of Hariz, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, he said:
"Indeed, ticks are not of the camel, while lice are of the camel."

key_terms.حَرِيزٍ: Hariz, the narrator named in the report

ai.seo_question: What is the legal difference between ticks and lice on a camel for the muhrim?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal distinction between two parasites found on a camel in the context of rulings for the muhrim. It indicates that the tick is not treated as part of the camel, whereas the louse is treated as part of the camel for legal consideration.
